本任务将 SUMMARY.md 中的目标落实到 `src/workspace/workspace.rs`，并与 `24-workspace §5, §6, §7, §8` 的 API、实现拆分和测试计划保持一致。

## 实施步骤

### Step 1: 实现核心代码

在 `src/workspace/workspace.rs` 中添加本任务要求的最小实现，保持职责边界与设计文档一致。

```rust
pub struct Workspace {
    pub(crate) ptr: core::ptr::NonNull<u8>,
    pub(crate) capacity: usize,
    pub(crate) alignment: usize,
    pub(crate) borrow_state: core::sync::atomic::AtomicU8,
    pub(crate) split_count: core::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize,
    _not_send_sync: core::marker::PhantomData<*mut ()>,
}

impl Workspace {
    pub const DEFAULT_ALIGNMENT: usize = 64;
    pub const MIN_ALIGNMENT: usize = 8;
    pub const DEFAULT_CAPACITY: usize = 4096;

    const BORROW_NONE: u8 = 0;
    const BORROW_READ: u8 = 1;
    const BORROW_EXCLUSIVE: u8 = 2;

    const GROWTH_FACTOR_NUMERATOR: usize = 3;
    const GROWTH_FACTOR_DENOMINATOR: usize = 2;

    pub fn capacity(&self) -> usize { self.capacity }
    pub fn alignment(&self) -> usize { self.alignment }

    pub fn new(capacity: usize, alignment: usize) -> crate::Result<Self> {
        if !alignment.is_power_of_two() || alignment < Self::MIN_ALIGNMENT {
            return Err(crate::error::XenonError::Workspace {
                operation: alloc::borrow::Cow::Borrowed("Workspace::new"),
                category: crate::error::WorkspaceErrorCategory::InvalidLayout {
                    size: capacity,
                    align: alignment,
                },
                cause: None,
            });
        }
        let size = capacity.max(1);
        let layout = alloc::alloc::Layout::from_size_align(size, alignment)
            .map_err(|_| crate::error::XenonError::Workspace {
                operation: alloc::borrow::Cow::Borrowed("Workspace::new"),
                category: crate::error::WorkspaceErrorCategory::InvalidLayout {
                    size,
                    align: alignment,
                },
                cause: None,
            })?;
        let ptr = unsafe { alloc::alloc::alloc(layout) };
        let ptr = core::ptr::NonNull::new(ptr).ok_or(crate::error::XenonError::Workspace {
            operation: alloc::borrow::Cow::Borrowed("Workspace::new"),
            category: crate::error::WorkspaceErrorCategory::AllocFailed {
                size, align: alignment,
            },
            cause: None,
        })?;
        Ok(Self {
            ptr,
            capacity: size,
            alignment,
            borrow_state: core::sync::atomic::AtomicU8::new(Self::BORROW_NONE),
            split_count: core::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0),
            _not_send_sync: core::marker::PhantomData,
        })
    }

    pub fn with_default_capacity() -> crate::Result<Self> {
        Self::new(Self::DEFAULT_CAPACITY, Self::DEFAULT_ALIGNMENT)
    }
}

impl Drop for Workspace {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        unsafe {
            let layout = alloc::alloc::Layout::from_size_align_unchecked(
                self.capacity,
                self.alignment,
            );
            alloc::alloc::dealloc(self.ptr.as_ptr(), layout);
        }
    }
}
```

### Step 2: 单元测试

> **强制要求**:
> - 本步骤必须包含一个或者多个单元测试。
> - 测试函数名称和测试内容必须参考对应设计文档的 **「测试计划」** 一节。
> - 编译检查与Lint检查不等同于单元测试。
> - 如果测试没有通过需要修复直至测试通过。
> - **无测试 = 任务未完成。**

测试依据: `test_workspace_new_basic`、`test_workspace_new_default`、`test_workspace_new_invalid_alignment`、`test_workspace_constants`、`test_alignment_verification` 覆盖构造和常量。

```rust
#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::Workspace;

    #[test]
    fn test_workspace_new_basic() {
        let workspace = Workspace::new(128, 64).unwrap();
        assert!(workspace.capacity() >= 128);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_workspace_new_default() {
        assert!(Workspace::with_default_capacity().is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_workspace_new_invalid_alignment() {
        // Zero is not a power of two (the power-of-two check catches this first)
        assert!(Workspace::new(64, 0).is_err());
        // Below MIN_ALIGNMENT
        assert!(Workspace::new(64, 4).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_workspace_constants() {
        assert!(Workspace::MIN_ALIGNMENT >= 8);
        assert!(Workspace::DEFAULT_ALIGNMENT >= Workspace::MIN_ALIGNMENT);
        assert!(Workspace::DEFAULT_CAPACITY > 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_alignment_verification() {
        assert!(Workspace::new(64, 3).is_err());
        assert!(Workspace::new(64, 64).is_ok());
    }
}
```

## 关键设计决策

| 决策 | 依据 |
|------|------|
| Workspace 暴露 MaybeUninit 视图 | `24-workspace.md §1.2` 要求未初始化感知 |
| 借用状态由 RAII guard 归还 | `24-workspace.md §5.6` 定义 Drop 释放状态 |
| ensure_capacity 只增长不缩容 | `24-workspace.md §1.2` 避免内存抖动 |

## 验证方式

1. 编译检查: `cargo check`
2. Lint 检查: `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features`
3. 测试验证: `cargo test workspace --all-features`
4. 手动验证: 运行一个创建、借用、释放、扩容的最小示例。

## 注意事项

- 借用期间不得重新分配或扩容。
- typed view 只能在 Element 闭集内使用，并由调用方证明初始化。
- Workspace 和所有 guard 保持 `!Send + !Sync`。
